clue.text: Be determined to succeed in humble firm

parts.note: humble in the sense of lowly or common gives mean, as in a mean dwelling
a firm is a company or business

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to get ahead while working at a modest company.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in earnest about getting results is the idiom for showing serious intent.

clue.text: Arabian fell-his mistake

parts.note: a fell is a stretch of upland or moor in northern England

indicators.note: a mistake means the letters of the next word are set wrong, rearranged

explanation.surface: A Bedouin's tumble is put down to his own error.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mistake' scrambles HIS into ISH. A fell is a northern English word for a moor or hillside.
explanation.definitionFit: The Moors of North Africa were of Arab and Berber descent, so Moorish loosely serves for Arabian style.

clue.text: Family member entertained by Lord Fauntleroy

indicators.note: entertained as a guest within the words, so the letters sit inside Lord Fauntleroy

explanation.surface: Little Lord Fauntleroy hosts a relative.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entertained by' points to letters held inside the name Fauntleroy.
explanation.definitionFit: A parent's sister is one of the relatives in a family.

clue.text: Little space in house for watching television?

definitions.text: Little space in house for watching television?

parts.words: Little space in house for watching television?
parts.note: television is colloquially the box, so a small room in a house reads jokingly as the room for the box

explanation.definitionFit: A tiny storage room in a house, punningly the room where one watches the box.

clue.text: Mass movement gives us scant excitement

indicators.note: excitement stirs the letters up, so the words us scant are rearranged

explanation.surface: A protest march leaves the speaker underwhelmed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'excitement' scrambles US SCANT. The surface 'mass movement' looks political; it means a section of the Mass.
explanation.definitionFit: The holy-holy-holy hymn is a fixed section of the Eucharist liturgy, set as a part of musical Masses.

clue.text: Mean to get close…

definitions.meaning: an old word for stingy or tight-fisted
as a verb, to approach or draw nigh

explanation.definitionFit: Stingy is an informal sense of the word, and to approach is its verb sense.

clue.text: … mean to be forgiving

explanation.definitionFit: Frugal is one sense, and showing mercy, as in sparing a life, is the other.

clue.text: Remarkable, to shoot security police

parts.note: remarkable or out of the ordinary means special
a shoot of a plant is a branch

explanation.surface: An astonishing gun-firing by the security forces.
explanation.walkthrough: Special Branch is the British police unit dealing with national security.
explanation.definitionFit: Special Branch is the name of the British police units handling national security.

clue.text: Woman setting ambush for royal attendant

parts.note: a lady is a woman
to set an ambush is to lie in waiting

explanation.surface: A female assassin lies in wait for a member of the court.
explanation.definitionFit: A noblewoman who serves a queen or princess holds that household title.

clue.text: Arizona city arose from the ashes

definitions.meaning: the mythical bird reborn from its own ashes, the clue's phrase describing it

explanation.definitionFit: The capital of Arizona shares its name with the fabled bird reborn from the fire.

clue.text: The US/Canada border falls here

parts.note: falls reads as where the frontier lies, but also as the waterfall on that frontier

explanation.definitionFit: The famous waterfall straddles the frontier between New York State and Ontario.

clue.text: Money I used in trick

indicators.note: in places the single letter inside the word for a trick

parts.note: a con is a swindle or trick

explanation.definitionFit: Metal pieces of currency are a form of cash, and the word also means money generally.

clue.text: Onwards to the bridge

definitions.meaning: forward, ahead, as in going out into the world
the ... Bridge, the famous Scottish railway bridge over the Firth of ...

explanation.definitionFit: The word means forward, and the Forth Bridge is the celebrated railway bridge near Edinburgh.

clue.text: Little Italian returned to city

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: It is an abbreviation for Italian, as in It vermouth
NY stands for New York City

explanation.surface: A small Italian came back to the big city.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiny and little are synonyms for small.

clue.text: A number appreciate it

parts.note: to dig something is slang for liking or appreciating it

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to value a particular figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Each numeral 0 to 9 is a single figure, so a digit is a number.

clue.text: Plaything easy to catch

definitions.meaning: in cricket a ... is a simple catch

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a dolly is a very simple catch for a fielder.
explanation.definitionFit: A doll is a toy, and cricket calls a simple chance a dolly catch.

clue.text: I don't believe I subscribe to this philosophy

definitions.text: I don't believe I subscribe to this philosophy

parts.words: I don't believe I subscribe to this philosophy
parts.note: read as a polite brush-off, but literally it is the creed of someone who does not believe in God

explanation.definitionFit: Disbelief in any god is the position of a non-believer.

clue.text: Arm that guided one to the altar?

definitions.text: Arm that guided one to the altar?

parts.words: Arm that guided one to the altar?
parts.note: arm suggests the father's arm leading a bride, but it is a firearm forcing a reluctant groom

explanation.definitionFit: A forced wedding is called a shotgun wedding, the firearm being the weapon that ensures the groom attends.

clue.text: For a change, used big birds as pets

indicators.note: a change of order means the letters of used big are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone tried large birds as companion animals for variety.
explanation.definitionFit: Budgerigars, informally budgies, are small parakeets kept as household pets.

clue.text: Tricky choice gives me a mild problem

indicators.note: problem signals the words me a mild are in trouble, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone finds a hard decision only slightly troubling.
explanation.definitionFit: A quandary between two unpleasant options is the classic sense.

clue.text: One whose name I forgot is a nuisance

definitions.meaning: a placeholder for an unnamed person

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase stands in for a forgotten name and also, euphemistically, for an unpleasant person.

clue.text: Arab potentate taking a grape

indicators.note: taking means the ruler takes the next letter alongside him

parts.note: a sultan is a Muslim sovereign ruler

explanation.surface: A sheikh helps himself to some fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: The sultana is a seedless white grape variety, best known dried.

clue.text: The highest achievement of church architecture?

definitions.text: The highest achievement of church architecture?

parts.words: The highest achievement of church architecture?
parts.note: highest achievement sounds like a masterpiece, but literally means the tallest structure on a church

explanation.definitionFit: A tall spire-topped tower is the loftiest part of many churches.

clue.text: Establish nothing is to interrupt a quiet beer

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation piano, meaning quietly

indicators.note: to interrupt is to break into, so the round letter goes inside the drink

parts.note: a pint is a glass of beer
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone sets up a rule that nothing should disturb a peaceful drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To install someone in a post or fix a time is to set it up, a synonym of the verb.

clue.text: Colleague a yard behind everyone

indicators.note: behind places the yard abbreviation after the word for everyone

parts.note: all means everyone
y is the abbreviation for a yard

explanation.surface: A workmate trails the whole team by a short distance.
explanation.definitionFit: A partner or associate on your side is an ally.

clue.text: Hammer offered to student

parts.note: offered means gave, as in gave a gift
L is the learner plate for a student driver

explanation.surface: A tool is presented to a pupil.
explanation.walkthrough: L stands for learner, the plate a British student driver displays.
explanation.definitionFit: The small mallet of an auctioneer or judge is a kind of hammer.

clue.text: After a second, ready to quarrel

indicators.note: after puts the word for ready following the abbreviation for a second

parts.note: s is the abbreviation for a second
pat means ready or prepared, as in having an answer off pat

explanation.surface: Within a moment, someone is spoiling for a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: A petty argument or squabble is a spat.

clue.text: Blonde-just

explanation.definitionFit: Light-coloured hair is described with this word, which also means impartial.

clue.text: Copy another's answer in pen

definitions.meaning: a stall or manger for animals

explanation.definitionFit: Cheating by copying is cribbing, and a crib is also an animal stall or manger.

clue.text: Committee person has day of authority

parts.note: a man is a person

explanation.surface: A committee member is in charge for a day.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in control or charge is a synonym of having authority.

clue.text: Share wine-the best is about to follow

indicators.note: to follow puts the word for about after the first parts

parts.note: port is a fortified wine from Portugal
the best is number one, the Roman numeral I
on means about, concerning, as in a talk on art

explanation.surface: Someone shares the wine, with the finest bottle still to come.
explanation.definitionFit: A portion is a part or share of something.

clue.text: Survive while ten colleagues are dismissed

definitions.text: Survive while ten colleagues are dismissed

parts.words: Survive while ten colleagues are dismissed
parts.note: in cricket, an opening batsman left not out when all ten partners are out is said to do this

explanation.walkthrough: A cricket term: the opener who is still in when the other ten batsmen are out.
explanation.definitionFit: The cricket idiom for an opener remaining not out through the whole innings.
